title: place_card_under
description:
Places a card under another card, out of play, e.g. to resolve an effect (Back-Alley Hideaway, Daidoji Uji, Kaiu Shihobu, Under Siege: the hand set aside under the stronghold, then added back to it with `add_card_to_hand`): from a deck, a hand, play, a province, a discard pile or from the cards removed from the game, under a card in play (a character, an attachment, a holding face up in a province, the stronghold) or a province. The cards under a card stay there until an effect takes them (they are played, put into play, into a province or a hand like the cards removed from the game), and are discarded when it leaves play. Face up, every player sees it; face down, only the owner of the card it is under. A card leaving play leaves its attachments, tokens and the conflict; a province left without dynasty card is refilled.

The cards can belong to any player: the engine does not apply card effects.

card_id.description: Conflict or dynasty card to place under the host card.

host_card_id.description: Card in play (character, attachment, holding face up in a province, stronghold) or province the card is placed under.

face_down.description: Whether the card is placed face down, known to the owner of the host card only; face up otherwise.
